_comment: Example Claude Desktop MCP config for industrial-hmi-mcp. Copy the mcpServers entry into your real config (Windows: %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), replace the command with the absolute path to your built binary, then restart Claude Desktop. Ask it e.g. 'are there any active alarms?' and it will call the alarms_snapshot tool.
